With over 230,000 EVs on the road, $1 billion in green bonds issued and world-leading solar manufacturing, Thailand is proving that clean energy transitions can be locally driven, nationally scaled & globally significant. And it's not stopping there.

This week, I had the privilege of presenting the just energy transition opportunities for Thailand at a multistakeholder dialogue co-hosted by the Government of Thailand and @UNDP. I unpacked how the country is already at the forefront of energy innovations, and what can be done to turn emerging challenges into bold opportunities:

1️⃣ Infrastructure That Works for People and Planet With 20 GW of untapped rooftop solar and a growing exposure to climate risks, Thailand can redesign its energy infrastructure toward decentralized, adaptive systems that boost both energy security and resilience.

2️⃣ Finance That Reaches the Last Mile Thailand issued $1B in green bonds in 2023. But $22B is still needed for renewables by 2037. Financial Innovation Labs (like UNDP’s Financial Innovation Labs) and national transition funds could unlock scaled, equitable investment - just as seen in Cuba and Brazil.

3️⃣ Data and Digital That Drive Equity Peer-to-peer solar trading in Bangkok already shows what's possible. With tools like the Clean Energy Equity Index, Thailand can harness AI and geospatial data to bring clean energy and channel investments to the communities that need it most.

4️⃣ Regional Leadership That Lifts All Boats Through ASEAN power trade, BRICS+ partnerships and the Indo-Pacific Clean Economy Agreement, Thailand is helping shape a new model of South-South cooperation. With Just Transition Innovation Zones, it’s ready to lead from the front.

As I said earlier this week: “Thailand is a leader for inclusive and sustainable growth. Not only in ASEAN, but globally.” The country’s energy ambitions are matched by its innovation and commitment to leave no one behind.

At @UNDP we’re proud to support Thailand in building an energy future that works for everyone. Because when Thailand advances a just energy transition, it doesn’t just transform its own future; it lights the way for the region and the world.

#EnergyForDevelopment #JustTransition #Thailand #InclusiveGrowth
